result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' section is clipped mid-word without an ellipsis and crowds the rating, and there are a couple of minor consistency/contrast issues. Carousel edge clipping and bottom viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is cut off mid-character (renders as 'Tokumaru Ramen' with the final letters sliced) instead of being truncated with an ellipsis, and it runs directly into the rating block '4.8 (500+)' on the same row.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the title width with flex/min-width:0, apply single-line truncation with text-overflow: ellipsis, and reserve fixed space plus a gap for the rating so the two never collide.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the ramen card it sits on a plain dark area with no visible container, while on the pizza card it has a distinct circular translucent background.
issues.suggestion: Use the same circular scrim/background for the heart button on all restaurant cards so the affordance is consistent and visible over any image.

issues.description: The search placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray field, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the input background.
